intro.title: Polling Hook
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a custom Angular hook that automatically fetches data from an API at regular intervals, known as polling. You'll learn how to use Angular's built-in RxJS Observables and the `interval` function to create timed data updates. The main technologies involved are Angular services, TypeScript, and reactive programming with RxJS operators like `switchMap`. By the end, you'll have a reusable polling hook that can be integrated into any Angular component to display live-updating data.
intro.usecase: A polling hook is essential for building real-time dashboards and live data feeds in applications like financial trading platforms, live sports score trackers, or collaborative project management tools. Developers use this pattern to periodically fetch updated data from a server, such as stock prices, delivery statuses, or team notifications, without requiring manual user refreshes. This ensures users always see the latest information, enhancing interactivity and responsiveness in features like live charts, activity logs, or status panels.
